D/ M AVREL ANTONINVS AVG ; R/ PROV DEOR TRP XV COS III

Silver coin. Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), issue of 161, Mint of Rome, RIC vol. 3 page 215 no. 25. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: M AVREL ANTONINVS AVG. Reverse description: Providentia standing left holding globe and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: PROV DEOR TRP XV COS III. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 2.37gms, die axis: 12
